title: P15.9 owner-action HTTP/UI seams + P16-A Brain Context Aggregator (R2 repair)
description: Step 0 (P15.9): owner POST routes /api/vnext/objectives/:id/{progress,evidence,amend}. Authority is ONLY x-operator-id via canonicalOperatorActor/operatorRef — coercion artifacts AND whitespace refs rejected at every identity edge; owner_authority_id additionally gated at the canonical SERVICE layer (assertOwnerAuthorityRef: operator:<non-artifact non-whitespace ref>) so no caller — HTTP, service or amend patch — can mint a permanently-unclaimable owner (R1-M1/R2-M1′; H5/H6). Body identity fields never substitute (H3); verifier is always the header actor; evidence_key required; source pinned owner-console; value typeof-strict finite (H4). amend rejects zero-key patches AND dedups on optional idempotency_key vs last_amendment.patch_digest — ambiguous retry never double-commits (R2-M2′; H7). accountBudget stays unexposed. 403s carry the error code only — authority messages name real owner/business ids (R2-M4′). Identity edges normalized across create/legacy/business/routine/cost/secret-policy/work-items/budgets/org-agents/ceo-cycle/auto-*/cockpit/reviews/signoff/company. UI: diff-only amendments, strict numeric/date entry, REVOKED tone, per-op idempotency keys, exact-body retry. Step 1 (P16-A): brain-context.ts contextFor — owner-gated strict read-only aggregation over ObjectiveCockpitService (payload+event hash footprint identical — B7). context_digest pins canonical state only: asof + clock-derived status fields stripped from digest input; verified against a REAL ObjectiveAutoPolicyService across a live expiry instant (B1b-real — a future now()-derived key would fail it, R2-M6′). KPI/budget re-proven directly — BINDING_ABSENT never misreports UNPROVEN (B1d); ~2x proof charge documented (R2-M3′); nested budget fails closed (B1c); autonomy sources list wired deps only (R2-M7′). Unscoped memory/experience SCOPE_BINDING_ABSENT. Tamper propagates (B2); CAS drops+reports (B4); business isolation (B5). Library-only.
